data.summary: The caddy directory is a configuration-only directory holding Caddy web-server config files that define reverse-proxy routing for the sandbox-mgr local development environment. Caddyfile is the active generated config mapping mgr.localhost to the management API and each sandbox hostname to its container port; Caddyfile.bak is a backup copy with identical routing rules. Because the file is machine-generated from the sandboxes database table, it is an infrastructure artifact rather than application logic.

file_insights.name: Caddyfile
file_insights.summary: Generated Caddy configuration that reverse-proxies the management UI/API and every sandbox hostname to its corresponding container and port.
file_insights.source_summary: The file consists solely of comment headers and three site blocks using the http:// scheme, each containing a single reverse_proxy directive. The mgr.localhost block targets mgr-api:8089, the sbx-devvv block targets sbx-devvv:8080, and the sbx-devvv-piweb block targets http://sbx-devvv-piweb:30141. There are no matchers, headers, TLS, or logging directives present.
file_insights.detailed_description: This Caddyfile is a declarative configuration file, not source code, that wires up the ingress layer for the sandbox-mgr environment. It defines an http://mgr.localhost site that reverse-proxies to the mgr-api service on port 8089, plus one site per sandbox (e.g. sbx-devvv.mgr.localhost -> sbx-devvv:8080 and sbx-devvv-piweb.mgr.localhost -> http://sbx-devvv-piweb:30141). The header comments state it is regenerated from the sandboxes table on every create/delete by mgr/src/caddy.rs, so it must never be edited manually.
responsibilities: Route mgr.localhost traffic to the management API at mgr-api:8089
Route each sandbox hostname to the sandbox's container and exposed port
Serve as the generated, machine-owned source of ingress routing rules
Mirror the sandboxes database table as Caddy site blocks

file_insights.name: Caddyfile.bak
file_insights.summary: Backup copy of the generated Caddyfile preserving the same reverse-proxy site definitions for the management API and sandbox hostnames.
file_insights.source_summary: The content mirrors Caddyfile exactly: a generated-by-sandbox-mgr comment header followed by http://mgr.localhost -> mgr-api:8089, http://sbx-devvv.mgr.localhost -> sbx-devvv:8080, and http://sbx-devvv-piweb.mgr.localhost -> http://sbx-devvv-piweb:30141. No additional directives or differences from the primary file are present.
file_insights.detailed_description: Caddyfile.bak is a backup artifact of the generated Caddy configuration, retaining the identical comment banner and the same three reverse_proxy site blocks. It exists so that the previous routing state can be restored if regeneration of Caddyfile fails or produces an invalid config. As a duplicate, it carries no independent behavior and should not be loaded by Caddy itself.
responsibilities: Preserve a previous revision of the generated Caddy routing config
Enable rollback if the freshly generated Caddyfile is invalid
Document the same sandbox-to-container proxy mappings as the active file
